### He Is Faithful, Even When We Are Faithless
Author: Alex Seeley
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-april-16-2026.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 32:4
Points:
- Difficult circumstances and painful delays can tempt believers to question God's faithfulness.
- Frustration often stems from imposing human expectations and timelines that God never promised.
- Moses proclaims that the Lord is the Rock whose deeds are perfect and just.
- Going through an adverse season does not mean God's character has stopped being good.
- Believers should posture their hearts and prayers in faith rather than fear while waiting on Him.

### A Rock Unchanging
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rock-unchanging
Passage: Deuteronomy 32:4
Points:
- Scripture describes God as a rock to highlight His essential immutability.
- Because God is entirely holy, His deeds and judgments are always righteous.
- The Lord serves as the solid, enduring foundation for all moral uprightness and integrity.
- Unlike human beings who routinely break promises, God unfailingly keeps His covenant commitments.
- Believers must choose to build their daily walk upon God's enduring truth rather than human opinion.
